# Performance Psychology Center

> A California-based sports psychology practice offering online mental health services, performance coaching, and athlete counseling led by licensed clinical psychologists.

Performance Psychology Center provides comprehensive sport psychology services including individual therapy, mental skills training, and the Champion's Mindset program. The practice serves individual athletes, coaches, and university athletic departments through telehealth and online platforms.

## Key Topics

- Sport Psychology
- Mental Skills Training
- Performance Coaching
- Champion's Mindset Program
- Clinical Psychology
- Athlete Mental Health
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
- Telehealth Services
- Mental Performance Consulting
- Student Athletes
- Athletic Department Services
- Online Therapy
- Crisis Intervention
- Joe Puentes (Founder, Psy.D.)
- Santa Rosa, California

## Core Services

- [Performance Psychology Services](https://www.performancepsychologycenter.com/services): Main services overview including therapy, mental skills training, and Champion's Mindset program.
- [Sports Psychology Therapy & Counseling](https://www.performancepsychologycenter.com/therapy): Individual therapy and counseling using cognitive behavioral therapy for athletes.
- [Psychology Training for Athletes](https://www.performancepsychologycenter.com/sport-psychology-training): Mental skills training for athletes, coaches, and professionals on sport psychology concepts.
- [Sport Psychology Services for Athletic Departments](https://www.performancepsychologycenter.com/services-for-athletic-departments): Telehealth services for athletic departments including crisis intervention and mental health support.

## Getting Started

- [Sport Psychology Consultation Call](https://www.performancepsychologycenter.com/initial-sport-psychology-call): Initial free consultation call to discuss sport psychology services and get started.
- [Mental Health Support](https://www.performancepsychologycenter.com/mental-health-support-covid19): Mental health crisis support and psycho-educational workshops for student athletes.
